title: GFN2-XTB + Delta(ZAFF) HDCPT2 fundamentals
summary: Build the normal-mode QFF from composite harmonic F2 and same-temperature GFN2-XTB F3/F4, then compute HDCPT2 fundamentals and an effective x matrix without a variational step.
gates: ZAFF field has separate QM and GFN2 Morse bond functions from fit v3
zero ZAFF reference energy, charges and nonbonded terms
identical atom order and geometry for composite F2 and GFN2 F3/F4
converged GFN2 SCC and analytic-Hessian CPSCF
positive active harmonic frequencies or explicit harmonic-mode treatment
finite and symmetric effective x matrix
coordinate_policy: Freeze the reference geometry and mass-weighted composite F2 modes; acquire raw GFN2 F3/F4 in that basis.
backend_policy: Use the resident GFN2Calculator analytic Hessian at the same electronic temperature as the fitted composite baseline.
